gtc.text: The Izzet League is the guild of fire and invention led by the dragon Niv-Mizzet, and Aurelia denounces Niv-Mizzet, ending the Warmind Initiative collaboration between the Boros and the Izzet.

A Gruul shaman, Kal, is sent by his clan leader to watch the Izzet and make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory, and he later channels what he learned from them into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates attacking Rakdos.
Borborygmos's elemental launches an assault on the Izzet in the Rubblebelt, but the Izzet wards hold and experiments continue.
